**Your PC**

**The log (please attach it)**
<!--
Open the folder you installed the game into, then "logs". Drag the newest fh1_NNN.log into this box, or the
one from the run that went wrong. After a crash, add logs\fh1.crash.txt too. A screenshot helps a lot.

A log can contain your Windows user name inside file paths: open it in Notepad first if that matters to you.
Never attach files of the game itself.
-->
